description: NO-REGRESSION fixture for saga #811 (issue #1087). Unlike its two siblings in this directory this asserts CORRECT behaviour that must survive the fix unchanged, and the distinction is normative rather than incidental: spec/ai-tutor.md:173 fixes `challenge`'s canonical signature as "a Command invoked as the bare word `challenge` with no inputs", so arity 0 is the contract and an excess input is a real error whatever #815 does about the missing evaluator. It is rejected at PARSE as `ol-bad-token` (stage `parse` per spec/error-model.md:110) with `params.text` naming the offending token, so nothing executes and `events` is empty — the identical cascade `fowad 100` produces, measured alongside it. Recorded because the arity path and the missing-evaluator path are independent: #815 must make bare `challenge` report `ol-not-implemented` WITHOUT disturbing this.
